title: Analytical errors in the laboratory of a general hospital of the Thai Red Cross Society: a 3-year experience
core_idea: A retrospective descriptive study of laboratory error records from 2021–2023 that categorizes and quantifies errors across pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical phases and by specimen source, using descriptive statistics and six sigma metrics to identify error types and frequencies with the goal of reducing preventable errors and improving overall laboratory quality.
tldr: Retrospective 3-year analysis of laboratory errors across testing phases to quantify types/frequencies and inform efforts to reduce preventable errors and improve quality.
